candidate.answerReason: The perpendicular half-diagonals have lengths 3 and 4, giving side length 5. Half the product of the diagonals is 24.

methods.label: Use the perpendicular half-diagonals
methods.explanation: The diagonals are perpendicular and bisect each other, so the side length is \(\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5\). The area is \(6\times8\div2=24\).
methods.levelReason: Rhombus diagonal properties, its area formula, and the Pythagorean theorem are Grade 8 material.
